label: EXPLORATORY. S1 and S2 validation is NOT EVALUABLE and is never upgraded by this test. protocol: WP5 sections 13-14 / LIF_DYNAMICS_SPEC 9.9 tuning protocol exactly as scripts/lattice_fix/measure_tuning_cpu.py (d6806ee): PhotoreceptorGratingEncoder i_max 20, lambda 30 deg, 1.5 Hz, contrast 1, no noise, step 2 ms; gray 1000 ms settle + 1000 ms baseline window, then per condition 500 ms grating settle + 2000 ms window (3 cycles) from the shared gray snapshot; conditions dir0, dir45, ..., dir315 (both eyes same lattice direction) plus yaw_ccw and yaw_cw; flicker excluded (zero spatial frequency, lattice-independent). For v6 the encoder level on R1-R6 is light (x 0.01, BG0 units): gray 10 = BG-1, grating 0-20 = 0-0.2.
runner: scripts/v6/measure_tuning_v6.py (copy of measure_tuning_cpu.py; asserts the encoder drives only R1-R6). v6 has NO GPU path: v6 runs on CPU, numba single thread per process, nice, taskset 0-3, each lattice arm split into two processes (dir0-dir135 + yaw_ccw | dir180-dir315 + yaw_cw), merged by scripts/v6/merge_parts.py which asserts the gray readouts are identical.

gates_per_lattice_arm.G1: verbatim 7.10 T4/T5 clause: DSI >= 0.2 in at least one T4/T5 subtype (per eye) whose D1 response magnitude is >= 0.5 mV
gates_per_lattice_arm.G2: opposite-preferring pair: for at least one of T4a/T4b, T4c/T4d, T5a/T5b, T5c/T5d (same eye), BOTH members have magnitude >= 0.5 mV and DSI >= 0.2 AND their preferred directions differ by >= 135 deg
gates_per_lattice_arm.G3: verbatim DNa02 yaw clause: yaw_ccw gives DNa02 L-R >= +1 Hz AND yaw_cw gives L-R <= -1 Hz
gates_per_lattice_arm.EXPLORATORY_PASS: G1 and G2 and G3, reported per lattice arm; no arm is selected after the fact

rules: Blind: the motion protocol has never been run under any v6 parameter set before this commit. No parameter, lattice, window, threshold or analysis change after seeing results; any rerun (crash only) is recorded with its reason. Results are reported for both lattice arms and all comparators whatever they show.
interpretation_limits: No result is claimed as calibrated-model evidence; a FAIL does not by itself localise the cause (input stage, medulla parameters, lattice, missing anatomy or engine), and a PASS does not validate S1/S2.
